_comment_named: With --all, `named` is a FILTER over discovered folders, not a name: each napplet deploys under its own folder name as the d tag. Keep it empty to deploy all of them. Note that `metadata.name` OVERRIDES this list entirely (config.ts resolves `named` as `metadata.name ? [metadata.name] : named`), so metadata.name must stay unset here or it silently filters every folder out and the deploy plan comes back empty.
_comment_metadata: title and description are deliberately absent. Config metadata REPLACES the per-napplet values, so setting them here would stamp one shared title onto every napplet. Each napplet's real title/description live in its vite.config.ts nip5aManifest({...}); the plugin writes them into the built index.html and deploy reads them back out from there. Edit the vite config, not the HTML. metadata.name must also stay unset — see _comment_named.
